summary: Full backend + frontend verification of Sentinel AI Runtime Governance MVP. 23/23 pytest cases pass; all critical UI flows work (login, sim/inject, agent create, policy create, audit filter, logout, protected route redirect). No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: Returns 200 even when agent belongs to another tenant / does not exist (silent no-op). Correctly leaves data intact (verified), but a 404 would be more RESTful and safer for clients.
Same silent no-op behaviour as above.

ui_bugs.issue: Calls navigate() during render when user is already set — produces React warning: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (AuthPage)'. Should use useEffect for redirect.
Console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — happens briefly when ResponsiveContainer mounts before layout is measured. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Convert AuthPage 'if(user) navigate(...)' into a useEffect to remove the React setState-in-render warning.
(Optional) Return 404 from DELETE /agents/{id} and /policies/{id} when the id does not exist under the current tenant.
(Cosmetic) Add minHeight to Recharts ResponsiveContainer to silence the width/height warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Cross-tenant isolation is enforced correctly on GET/PATCH/POST /evaluate/decisions/escalations — verified via tests.
JWT + httpOnly cookie + Bearer fallback all work; /auth/me strips password_hash and _id.
Seed function is idempotent (updates admin password if changed, only seeds sample data when org has none).
Decision engine matches policies in priority order and computes risk correctly; escalations table is written on 'escalate' effect.
server.py is a single 730-line file — consider splitting into routers/ (auth.py, agents.py, policies.py, evaluate.py, analytics.py) as it grows past MVP.
CORS uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True — works but is broad; tighten to explicit origins list for production.
DELETE endpoints are non-idempotent-friendly but silent — see minor issue above.
test_credentials: admin@sentinel.ai / Admin@2026 (seeded on startup, verified). File /app/memory/test_credentials.md present and correct.
seed_data_creation: Startup seed creates admin user + 4 sample agents + 5 sample policies for Sentinel Labs org. Test-created 'TEST_' data was cleaned up after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend and frontend are fully green. Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (23 tests, ~4s parallel via pytest-xdist). When automating UI, toasts from 'Welcome back' or successful actions can transiently overlap top-right buttons like new-agent-button — prefer JS click (page.evaluate("...click()")) or wait ~3s after navigation. All required data-testid attributes exist (auth-page, auth-email/password/submit, nav-*, simulate-button, refresh-button, inject-one/many-button, live-toggle, filter-{all|allow|block|modify|escalate}, decision-row-*, new-agent-button, agent-name/framework/trust/capabilities-input, agent-save-button, agent-card-*, agent-delete-*, new-policy-button, policy-name/priority/subject/action/resource/effect-*, policy-save-button, policy-row-*, policy-toggle-*, policy-delete-*, audit-search-input, audit-decision-filter, audit-table, audit-row-*, logout-button, dashboard-layout).
rca of the issue: No blocking issue. Two minor cosmetic issues explained above.
